testcase.name: Scenario: Transfer a selected command after reversing the source list: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:710:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Transfer a selected command after reversing the source list ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands in ascending order for an empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available command list ✔ And the user clicks the available command list Name header ✔ Then the visible source list begins with the separator and descending Zoom commands ✔ And the add transfer button remains enabled ✔ When the user clicks the add transfer button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the custom panel list ✔ And the target indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
